successors.name: Gran Colombia
successors.text: 'The Republic ended after the Congress of Angostura of 1819 decreed the union of Venezuela with New Granada'

ledger.x: 19 July 1817: the Guayana Campaign gives the republicans a base on the Orinoco.
February 1819: Margarita Island votes at Angostura.
17 December 1819: the Congress of Angostura creates the Republic of Colombia.
17 December 1819: the Third Republic of Venezuela ends in Gran Colombia.

wars.name: Venezuelan War of Independence (1817-1819 phase)
wars.outcome: The republicans hold Guayana and the Orinoco from 1817; 'a stalemate' in 1818 between the patriots at Angostura and Morillo's royalists in Caracas; in 1819 the patriots defeat Morillo and Morales in Apure and win Boyacá in August 1819; the Congress of…

certainty.note: No frontier is described on any page: the republic is a patriot base on the Orinoco facing royalist Caracas, with no surveyed or treaty line.
